shortDescription: This module manages user on IBM Spectrum Virtualize family storage systems

options.name: auth_type
options.description: Specifies whether the user authenticates to the system using a remote authentication service or system authentication methods. Only supported value is 'usergrp'. Required when I(state=present), to create a user.

options.name: clustername
options.description: The hostname or management IP of the Spectrum Virtualize storage system.

options.name: domain
options.description: Domain for the Spectrum Virtualize storage system. Valid when hostname is used for the parameter I(clustername).

options.name: forcepasswordchange
options.description: Specifies that the password is to be changed on next login. Applies when I(state=present), to modify a user.

options.name: keyfile
options.description: Specifies the name of the file containing the Secure Shell (SSH) public key. Applies when I(state=present).

options.name: lock
options.description: Specifies to lock the account indefinitely. The user cannot log in unless unlocked again with the parameter I(unlock). Applies when I(state=present), to modify a user. Parameters I(lock) and I(unlock) are mutually exclusive.

options.name: nokey
options.description: Specifies that the user's SSH key is to be deleted. Applies when I(state=present), to modify a user.

options.name: nopassword
options.description: Specifies that the user's password is to be deleted. Applies when I(state=present), to modify a user.

options.name: password
options.description: REST API password for the Spectrum Virtualize storage system. The parameters I(username) and I(password) are required if not using I(token) to authenticate a user.

options.name: state
options.description: Creates or updates (C(present)) or removes (C(absent)) a user.

options.name: token
options.description: The authentication token to verify a user on the Spectrum Virtualize storage system. To generate a token, use the ibm_svc_auth module.

options.name: unlock
options.description: Specifies to unlock the account so it can be logged in to again. Applies when I(state=present), to modify a user. Parameters I(lock) and I(unlock) are mutually exclusive.

options.name: user_password
options.description: Specifies the password associated with the user. Applies when I(state=present).

options.name: usergroup
options.description: Specifies the name of the user group with which the local user is to be associated. Applies when I(state=present) and I(auth_type=usergrp).

options.name: username
options.description: REST API username for the Spectrum Virtualize storage system. The parameters I(username) and I(password) are required if not using I(token) to authenticate a user.
